dedupe_keys.name: kiwirail rail network layers network risk rating and freight disruption status new zealand

description: KiwiRail, which runs New Zealand's rail network, shares several public GIS layers. The network risk rating layer gives current risk ratings for sections of the network from the Maximo asset management system; KiwiRail uses it to prioritise maintenance, asset renewal and risk mitigation such as flood protection, and shares it for planning such as lifelines and emergency management. The freight lines layer maps the freight network as polylines in NZTM with about 0.5 m accuracy, and the freight status layer and disruption web map show lines disrupted for freight trains now or in future, updated for customers. Coverage is national (New Zealand). The layers are free under CC BY 4.0 and available as ArcGIS feature services and a web map. Caveats: the data are for mapping and planning, not survey or design, the status layers are illustrative, and KiwiRail accepts no liability for errors; nobody may enter the rail corridor without a permit. The layers support hazard exposure and criticality analysis of rail lines, disruption and recovery tracking after floods and earthquakes, and lifelines planning. They complement the Network Rail open data feeds and are related to the Infrabel open data.
name: KiwiRail rail network layers, network risk rating and freight disruption status (New Zealand)
